description.zh: 老板专属常驻参谋团：AI专家卡帕西·产品专家乔布斯·制造业业务专家·内容操盘手·工作助理。五个角色各自绑定真实场景产出，不是人格空壳。人格层由女娲蒸馏并可增量更新，职责层与输出契约由工程侧锁定。
description.en: Owner's resident advisory board: AI expert (Karpathy), product expert (Jobs), manufacturing ops expert, B2B content operator, and chief of staff. Every role is bound to a real scene with a verifiable output contract.

welcome_message.zh: 我是你的经营参谋团。给我一句话目标、一条异常，或一件想对外讲的事，我按「AI可靠性 ‖ 现场算账 → 产品取舍 → 内容落地 → 收敛」出产出，每段都有可验收物，不给空话。
welcome_message.en: Your advisory board. Give me one goal or one anomaly; I return four role outputs with verifiable artifacts.

title.zh: 补料率异常：要不要停线

description.en: Line B 5.1%→7.2% in 7d. Stop line or maintain first?

prompt.zh: B产线补料率连续7天从5.1%爬到7.2%。要不要停线排查？给我一套能拍板的方案。
prompt.en: Line B feedrate 5.1%→7.2% in 7d. Stop the line or not? Give me a decidable plan.

description.zh: 巡检数据能发现问题，但车间不执行
description.en: Inspections surface issues; the floor ignores them

prompt.zh: 巡检系统每天都能看到问题，但车间不按建议执行。这个产品该砍什么、留什么？
prompt.en: Inspections surface problems daily, but the floor ignores the advice. What should this product cut?

description.zh: 前3天数据缺失，AI结论还能信吗
description.en: Days 1-3 missing. Can we trust the AI?

prompt.zh: 补料率爬升的数据前3天缺失（空值率15%）。这条AI归因链路还能不能信？给我可执行的验证切片。
prompt.en: Feedrate rose but days 1-3 are missing (15% null). Is this AI pipeline trustworthy? Give me an executable validation slice.

description.zh: 修好了模具，能不能把过程发出去
description.en: Mold fixed — can we publish the story?

prompt.zh: M-03 模具磨损导致补料率爬升，换模+保养后恢复正常。这件事能不能做成一条内容？我想让同行知道我们真在车间里解决问题。
prompt.en: Mold wear raised feedrate; after maintenance and changeover it normalized. Can this become a piece of content?
